title: Specialty Guideline Management at Renewal — Utilization Management Program
content:
**Policy.** When the member's Utilization Management Program package applies specialty guideline management, a renewal of a specialty drug is approved only with documented response to therapy (the ground of the clinical information being *documented response*) and a dose within the labeled range; otherwise it is denied with *criteria not met*, and the member's specialty enrollment goes on hold when the current approval expires. When the package does not apply it, specialty renewals follow the general renewal rule.

## Outcomes of a specialty renewal under guideline management

| Documented response to therapy | Dose within the labeled range | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | both conditions of guideline management are met |
| Yes | No | denied, *criteria not met*; specialty enrollment on hold when the current approval expires |
| No | Yes | denied, *criteria not met*; specialty enrollment on hold when the current approval expires |
| No | No | denied, *criteria not met*; specialty enrollment on hold when the current approval expires |

Guideline management applies on Northbridge Clinical Advanced Plus, Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive and Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive Specialty; on Northbridge Clinical Essentials, Standard and Advanced, specialty renewals follow the general renewal rule.

*Hypothetical case:* a Skyrizi renewal on Northbridge Clinical Comprehensive whose clinical information documents the dose but no response to therapy is denied *criteria not met*, and the member's specialty enrollment goes on hold once the current approval expires.
